special_offers: A Minimum Length of stay between 3-5 nights is required and and will vary by destination.
So there will be no price adjustments after the booking is completed.
restrictions: *For a reservation to qualify, the Special Rate Code "FC REWARD ONE MORE NIGHT" clearly indicating the offer, must be selected at time of booking.
If you do not see FC Reward-One More Night appear dynamically in the room/rate results over the dates of your stay, the FREE Night offer is not available.
All offers are subject to availability, blackout dates & other restrictions which may apply.
Offers may be Discontinued w/o Prior Notice.

closing.text: Book through WhataHotel's preferred rate and you'll get complimentary Wi-Fi, free daily breakfast for two, priority for an upgrade at check-in when one is available, and a $100 hotel credit, or $200 for suites. That preferred-rate offer can also be combined with the hotel's listed exclusive perks, subject to each offer's terms.
